positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Continued development of features to support our client base and internal systems in a microservice architecture using c#, .net core, JavaScript, Node, MongoDB/CosmosDB, SQL, Azure DevOps, Git, HTML, CSS, Sass, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Kibana, SwaggerHub, Docker, Kubernetes, on a microservice architecture.

- Document and maintain Apis in SwaggerHub using API first approach.

- Implemented micro-service design for both private and public APIs.

- Develop and maintain a suite with more than 50 microservices with a mixture of public facing and in-house steak holders.

- Provide rapid response to any production issues with any of the microservices mentioned above.

- As an integrations team we had to provide solutions that will be flexible enough to work with a variety of systems.

- Met with stakeholders and gather requirements which then needed to be translated into implementation details to create proper solutions.

- Refactor, improve and update existing implementations as requirements or technologies change.

- Worked ON UI components using JavaScript.

- Built and managed back-end orchestration of Docker images for DotNet Core microservices and MongoDB databases in Azure DevOps.

- Worked in an agile/scrum environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintain Microservices architecture to support our client base involving the use of .net, c#, .net core, JavaScript, CosmosDB, Azure Event Grid, Azure DevOps, Git, HTML, CSS, sass, and Vue.js.

- Implemented third parties APIs into integrated microservices.

- Maintained and supported internal systems. 

- Gave production support for the application/website.

- Served as a mentor to new hires/junior developers.

- Refactored interfaces and their implementation for better performance and scalability with the architecture.

- Code-Reviewed before integrating with larger collaborative branches.

- Implemented full-stack for features including back-end, front-end, database changes, unit tests, and integration tests.

- Followed CI/CD Practices utilizing Azure DevOps, Git, Azure, Karate Integrations tests, Cypress, and Units tests to ensure new and old features were working as expected.

- Worked in an agile/scrum environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Maintained and developed new features for class action suits payment application using c#, .net/dotnet core, SQL, Asp .Net, HTML, CHTML, Razor, JavaScript, and other C# focus technologies.

-	Improved architecture of current application using principles such as SOLID, Clean Coding, Cloud technologies, and others.

-	Developed proof of concepts to show areas that could be improved by changing current architecture.

- Utilized TFS and Units tests to ensure new and old features were working as expected.
-	Worked in an agile/scrum environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Redesigned a monolithic c#, .net structure into several microservices using c#, DotNet core, RabbitMQ, T-Sql, and other C# focus technologies.

- Implemented microservice design of the private API for the front end.

- Developed the front-end implementation for several pages of the website using AngularJS, JavaScript, npm, node, CSS, HTML, and other common tools necessary for front end development.

- Worked in an agile/scrum environment.

- Developed new features to support our client base involving the use of .net, c#, .net core, AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, sass, microservices.

- Expanded application’s functionality so the system can handle multiple locations, which resulted in better client acquisition

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	 Developed new features to support our client base involving the use of .net, c#, .net core, JavaScript, tsql, Nhibernate, html, CSS, sass, Knockout.js, React.js, paket, microservices. 
 
-	 Designed and developed public and private API to serve the needs of the clients and the internal system. 
 
-	 Implemented auth process using SAML for our clients. 
 
-	 Revamped the front end of the website. 
 
-	 Maintained and supported internal system for serving quotes to our clients. 

- Debugged and modified software components. 
 
- Code-Reviewed software pieces before integrating with larger collaborative branches.
- Implement UI front-end components using ReactJs.
- Followed CI/CD Practices utilizing Git, TeamCity, Cypress, and Units tests to ensure new and old features were working as expected.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Built, tested, and deployed scalable, highly available, modular software, and web application including web APIs products. Used Domain Driven Development Design Pattern and Test-Driven Development Pattern under .net framework implementing C# programming language, Azure database engine, and NuGet package manager. 
 
-Modify existing software to correct errors, implement new architecture, adapt to new hardware, improve availability to more users, and improve performance. 
 
-Designed Command line tool implemented using Power-Shell commands to optimize the development process. 
 
-Performed regression and system-level testing to verify software quality and function before it was released. 

-Identified and suggested new technologies and tools for enhancing product value and increasing team productivity. 
 
-Collaborated with product management to design, build, and test systems. 
 
-Debugged and modified software components. 
 
-Designed .Net/C#-based multi-threaded admin web applications. 
 
-Implemented token-based system authorization for web application. 
 
-Code-Reviewed software pieces before integrating with larger collaborative branch.

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Maintained and developed new features for the Lingotek translation software platform (javaEE/Struts/ Cassandra/Amazon web Services/PostgreSQL/Restful web Platform). 
 
-Improved the logs for the Lingotek translation software platform (javaEE/Struts/Jersey/PostgreSQL/ Restful Web Platform/Logstash). 
 
-Modified existing software to correct errors, adapt to new hardware, and improve performance.
